notes.title: Brushes with Death, Horse Racing-Update 1.3 is OUT NOW 🎨
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983656/e643f2edb85eb364018d7a9e50dffe74684196b3.png[/img]

[h2]Update 1.3 is here - featuring two big additions.[/h2]

[h3]The [i]Brushes with Death[/i] DLC and the free [i]Horse Racing[/i] DLC are now live, bringing new quests, new features, and fresh ways to explore Bohemia.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983656/2491085267694f6c172380238e1bcdd832f9455a.jpg[/img]

[h2][i]Brushes with Death[/i] - DLC Available Now[/h2]
[h3]A strange painter. A painted skull. A masterpiece in the making.[/h3]

Help a mysterious artist unravel his past in a series of quests across both maps. Along the way, unlock Shield Painting - a new feature letting you customise your shield with 100+ unique designs and colour combinations.

[h3][url=https://youtu.be/YhcCQCZh6P0]Watch the trailer NOW![/url][/h3]

[b]Included in the Kingdom Come: Deliverance II Gold Edition and Expansion Pass.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983656/523e09efd67446570762045c33bb0c9e734bbcbe.jpg[/img]

[h2][i]Horse Racing[/i] – Final Free DLC[/h2]
[h3]Ride like the wind.[/h3]

Take part in challenging new horse races and mounted archery contests to test your reflexes, accuracy, and riding skills across multiple courses.

[h2]Update 1.3 is live now.[/h2]
Gold Edition and Expansion Pass owners get [i]Brushes with Death[/i] automatically.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.2.2 – Fixes for trespassing, UI, and other issues 🛠️
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983656/1c0cfbb525f6f54b54ce7ff739ffb2f0e590b406.png[/img]

[h2]Hotfix 1.2.2 is here![/h2]

[b]This update brings several key fixes to improve your experience in Kingdom Come: Deliverance II. Say farewell to uninvited trespassing warnings in your rented rooms, worry less about accidentally overwriting your playlines, and enjoy a more stable experience overall.[/b]

[h3]Fixes and Improvements 🔧[/h3]
[list]
[*] [u][b]Room Renting:[/b][/u] No more trespassing flags in rented rooms after leaving and returning.
[*] [u][b]UI:[/b][/u] Removed New Game from the in-game pause menu to prevent accidental save overwrites.
[*] [u][b]Into the Underworld Quest:[/b][/u] Fixed Goatskin disappearing when loading saves from version 1.1.X after updating.
[*] [u][b]Other Fixes:[/b][/u] Resolved a bug where closing the barber overlay with a mouse would break the main menu.
[/list]
[b]Thank you for your patience and support—more updates are on the way!
[/b]
